source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: A **critical wound** with this weapon deals its Damage as **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)** after normal damage. Keep the mortal wounds from each attack on one model, discarding any excess when that model is **destroyed**. **[Feel No Pain](vsdata:core-ability/feel-no-pain)** still applies.

effect.mortalWounds: attack's Damage, including Melta and a critical wound's own Damage

detail.feelNoPain: applies, including mortal-only Feel No Pain
